questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: Which logic gate outputs 1 only when BOTH of its inputs are 1?
questions.hint: Think of the word — A AND B both have to be true.
questions.explanation: AND outputs 1 only when input A AND input B are both 1. Otherwise the output is 0.

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: Which logic gate outputs 1 when AT LEAST ONE of its inputs is 1?
questions.hint: One OR the other (or both) is enough.
questions.explanation: OR outputs 1 when either input is 1, or when both are 1. It only outputs 0 when both inputs are 0.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: Which logic gate has only ONE input and flips it (0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0)?
questions.hint: It inverts — the opposite of what goes in.
questions.explanation: The NOT gate (also called an inverter) takes one input and outputs the opposite. NOT 0 = 1 and NOT 1 = 0.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: How many inputs does a NOT gate have?
questions.hint: It only needs the one signal to flip.
questions.explanation: A NOT gate has exactly 1 input and 1 output. It inverts the input.

KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: A logic gate is drawn as a flat-backed shape that curves to a point on the right (a 'D' shape). Which gate is it?
questions.hint: Two straight sides on top and bottom, rounded nose on the output side.
questions.explanation: The AND gate symbol is a D-shape: a flat back with a rounded front pointing to the output.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: A logic gate is drawn as a shape with a curved back and a pointed front, like a shield or rocket nose. Which gate is it?
questions.hint: Curved on the input side, comes to a point at the output.
questions.explanation: The OR gate symbol has a curved back (input side) and a pointed front (output side), often described as a shield or rocket shape.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: A logic gate is drawn as a triangle pointing right with a small circle (bubble) at its tip. Which gate is it?
questions.hint: The little bubble on the output means 'invert'.
questions.explanation: The NOT gate symbol is a triangle pointing to the right with a small circle at the output. The circle (bubble) represents inversion.

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: An AND gate has inputs A=1 and B=1. What is the output?
questions.hint: AND needs both inputs to be 1.
questions.explanation: 1 AND 1 = 1. This is the only input combination where AND outputs 1.

KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: An AND gate has inputs A=1 and B=0. What is the output?
questions.hint: AND only outputs 1 when both inputs are 1.
questions.explanation: 1 AND 0 = 0. If either input is 0, an AND gate outputs 0.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: An OR gate has inputs A=1 and B=0. What is the output?
questions.hint: OR only needs ONE input to be 1.
questions.explanation: 1 OR 0 = 1. The OR gate outputs 1 whenever at least one input is 1.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: An OR gate has inputs A=0 and B=0. What is the output?
questions.hint: Neither input is 1, so OR has nothing to output.
questions.explanation: 0 OR 0 = 0. The OR gate only outputs 0 when BOTH inputs are 0.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: A NOT gate has input A=0. What is the output?
questions.hint: NOT flips the input.
questions.explanation: NOT 0 = 1. The NOT gate inverts its single input.

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt:
Complete the AND truth table. What goes in the missing output?

A | B | A AND B
0 | 0 | 0
0 | 1 | 0
1 | 0 | ?
1 | 1 | 1
questions.hint: For AND, both inputs must be 1 — B is 0 here.
questions.explanation: 1 AND 0 = 0. The AND gate outputs 1 only when both inputs are 1, so any row containing a 0 gives output 0.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt:
Complete the OR truth table. What goes in the missing output?

A | B | A OR B
0 | 0 | 0
0 | 1 | ?
1 | 0 | 1
1 | 1 | 1
questions.hint: OR needs at least one input to be 1.
questions.explanation: 0 OR 1 = 1. The OR gate outputs 1 whenever any input is 1.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: Order the four outputs of an AND gate truth table, from the row A=0 B=0 down to A=1 B=1.
questions.hint: Only the very last row (1 AND 1) outputs 1.
questions.explanation: AND truth table outputs in order are: 0, 0, 0, 1. Only when both inputs are 1 does AND output 1.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: Order the four outputs of an OR gate truth table, from the row A=0 B=0 down to A=1 B=1.
questions.hint: Only the very first row (0 OR 0) outputs 0.
questions.explanation: OR truth table outputs in order are: 0, 1, 1, 1. Only when both inputs are 0 does OR output 0.

questions.prompt: Which of the following input combinations make an AND gate output 1? (Select all that apply.)
questions.hint: AND only fires when BOTH inputs are 1.
questions.explanation: An AND gate only outputs 1 for A=1, B=1. All three other combinations contain at least one 0, so the output is 0.

questions.hint: OR outputs 1 unless both inputs are 0.
questions.explanation: OR outputs 1 whenever at least one input is 1. The only combination that gives 0 is A=0, B=0.

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: A NOT gate is connected to the output of an AND gate. The AND gate inputs are A=1 and B=1. What is the final output after the NOT gate?
questions.hint: Work out the AND first, then flip it with the NOT.
questions.explanation: AND of 1 and 1 = 1. NOT of 1 = 0. This combination is called a NAND gate.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: A NOT gate is connected to the output of an OR gate. The OR gate inputs are A=0 and B=0. What is the final output after the NOT gate?
questions.hint: Work out the OR result first, then flip it.
questions.explanation: OR of 0 and 0 = 0. NOT of 0 = 1. This combination is called a NOR gate.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: A burglar alarm rings only when the alarm is switched on AND a sensor detects movement. Which logic gate best models this?
questions.hint: Both conditions have to be true at the same time.
questions.explanation: Both conditions (alarm on AND sensor triggered) must be true for the alarm to ring, so this is an AND gate.

further_learning.title: Computer Systems and Data Science – Oak National Academy
KS3 Computing – BBC Bitesize

questions.subject: computing
questions.prompt: A car has a warning light that comes on if EITHER the driver's door is open OR the passenger door is open (or both). Which gate models this?
questions.hint: Either input being true is enough.
questions.explanation: If either door triggers the light, the OR gate fits — it outputs 1 when at least one input is 1.
